args.name: ONE LAST TRY — Gaming Challenge Thumbnail

style.prompt: Create a bright, punchy YouTube gaming challenge thumbnail, widescreen 16:9. Strong two-part layout readable at tiny sizes. LEFT half: gigantic bold condensed block typography with exactly these three words, spelled correctly: "ONE LAST TRY", arranged on three lines ONE / LAST / TRY. White and vivid yellow letters with thick black outline and subtle dimensional shadow; keep all letters fully inside frame with generous safe margins. RIGHT half: huge close-up shocked face of an entirely invented young adult gamer, no resemblance to any real celebrity, eyes wide, eyebrows raised, mouth open in excited disbelief, expressive and appealing, realistic detailed face with dramatic lighting, head and shoulders wearing a simple electric-blue gaming shirt. Face occupies most of right half, does not overlap or obscure text. Energetic generic video-game challenge background, electric purple and cobalt blue, hot pink accents, neon yellow lightning bolts, stylized pixel particles and speed streaks, a subtle abstract platform-game obstacle silhouette, no identifiable game branding. Vibrant high contrast, polished professional thumbnail compositing, crisp subject cutout with bright cyan rim light and bold outline, uncluttered focal hierarchy, exciting fun last-attempt challenge atmosphere. Only visible text is ONE LAST TRY. No logos, no watermarks, no extra lettering, no split panel borders.
